finding: A public generic FactSource wrapper over a real validated NativeCatalog returned scanned EntityRef with matching snapshot but a nonexistent occurrence. Its own validate_entity rejects the same entity, yet both Streaming and MaterializedReference execute return successful QueryOutput.
scope: Synthetic inconsistent custom FactSource only. ScopedPrepared uses sealed built-in Native/ReferenceCatalog and was not shown to accept a forged occurrence. This is not observed real APK/HostLab or complete audit success.
cost_and_blocker: NativeCatalog validates occurrence by linear scan and definitions by linear definition search; MemoryCatalog validates by scanning all tables and rows. Calling validate_entity for every scanned entity may be quadratic, and provider callback work is not bounded by current Control steps. A correct fix needs an authenticated, budgeted entity roster/index or explicit sealed trust boundary and integration without misclassifying errors; this is not implemented here.
test_policy: The failing default test was saved as an exact patch after actual runs, then removed from the tracked Rust test module; no default skip or claimed pass.
